summary: Petrobras filed a Form 6-K containing its 2Q26 results presentation. The document announces record production of 3.34 MMboed, operational efficiency gains, and several acquisitions of exploration blocks and work interests in Brazil and Africa (Block 3 São Tomé and Príncipe, Argonauta Field, Itaimbezinho Block). However, these are ordinary business updates and exploratory advances for a major oil producer, not special-situation transactions with disclosed deal terms. No premium, price, or shareholder vote details are provided. The filing is routine operational reporting, so no special-situation classification applies.
